Two friends die after alleged online gaming losses in Punjab

In Nawanshahr, Punjab, three friends allegedly consumed poison after incurring significant losses in online gaming. Two of the friends have died, while the third is receiving medical treatment. Police stated that the three shared a close friendship and engaged in online gaming together. Initial information suggests one of the youths faced substantial financial losses through gaming.
